key_idea: The proof evaluates the exponential graph of the strong product of a large clique and a graph with high girth and fractional chromatic number, using an elementary counting argument to restrict proper colorings and force a contradiction.
reason: This is a quintessential 'book proof' that resolved a 50-year-old major open problem in barely two pages. It achieves a profound result through an extraordinarily economical, conceptual counting argument and an unexpected construction, requiring absolutely no heavy machinery.
recognized: Shitov's counterexample to Hedetniemi's conjecture (Annals of Mathematics, 2019)
